name: io.github.madebyfyi/madeby
description: Disclose AI authorship of code. Tools for an AI coding agent to record who authored its work per the ACO standard (human/with_ai/ai): disclose (Authored-by-ai trailer), who (read what a repo discloses), check (gate PRs), init (add the AGENTS.md convention). Disclosure, not detection — reads only what commits put on the record, never the code.
